syllabus_topics: The Great Questions of Human Existence
In Search of Happiness. The Ends of Human Life
Critical Judgment, Polarization, Respect, and Tolerance
The Human Person as a Social Being

assessment_methods.method: Group work: development and presentation of collaborative projects
Continuous assessment: follow-up tests, practical activities and in-class tasks

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is based on a 40% final written exam, 30% evaluation of two compulsory readings, 20% group work, and 10% continuous assessment. An additional 10% bonus can be obtained for an optional reading. Any attempt at fraud, copying, or plagiarism is considered a serious infraction. For the extraordinary call, evaluation consists of a 60% written exam on course content and 40% evaluation of two compulsory readings.
